manifest.description: Maintenance tool: regenerate defdelegate blocks on a facade module to mirror backing modules' public def surface via add_elixir_facade_delegations.
when_to_use: a facade module (e.g. Substrate) re-exports many backing modules and one or more backings have gained/lost public defs
operator wants to incrementally widen a facade by mirroring a specific backing module's surface
anti_patterns: do not use to invent a new facade — the facade module file must exist
do not use when backing modules emit functions through defmacro (defdelegate can't dispatch macros)

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-facade-wire. Charter: regenerate defdelegate lines on a facade.

Protocol:
1. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="add_elixir_facade_delegations", source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={...}). Inspect added/removed/kept_existing/renames.
2. Refuse on no_filters (>= 50 backing publics + no filter set).
3. Apply with mix compile.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<added count + removed count + renames count>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{name_filter}} {{arity_filter}} {{as_renames}} {{keep_existing}} {{apply}}
